# Scent World Canada

> Scent diffusers, fragrance oils and scent marketing for businesses
> and homes. Based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Ships across Canada.

## What we sell
- [Commercial scent diffusers](https://www.scentworld.ca/commercial-scent-diffusers): spaces of 500 to 5,000 sq ft. The [S30](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/s30), [S200](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/s200) and [S300](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/s300) connect to HVAC; the S200 and S300 have app control and an anti-theft lock. The [S100](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/s100) covers 1,500 to 3,000 sq ft.
- [S20 Nano diffuser](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/s20): single rooms up to 500 sq ft.
- [Car scent diffuser](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/car-diffuser) and [car diffuser gift set](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/car-gift-set).
- [29 fragrance oils for diffusers](https://www.scentworld.ca/shop?filter=oils), for example [Oud](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/oud) and [White Tea](https://www.scentworld.ca/products/white-tea).
- Custom signature scents and auto-refill delivery for businesses.
- Current prices: [Shop](https://www.scentworld.ca/shop)

## Who we work with
- [Hotels](https://www.scentworld.ca/industries/hotels.html)

## Where we work
Based in Halifax, NS. Clients across Atlantic Canada, including Halifax,
Dartmouth, Bedford, Moncton, Fredericton and Charlottetown. We ship to
every Canadian province.

## Shipping and returns
Free shipping over $150 CAD in Canada. Orders processed in 24-48 hours
and delivered in 3-8 days, tracked. 30-day returns.
- [Shipping policy](https://www.scentworld.ca/shipping.html)
- [Returns and refunds](https://www.scentworld.ca/refund.html)

## Hours
Monday-Friday 9am-6pm Atlantic time. Weekends by appointment.
